$schema-note: Import everything from '@brd/ui'. Colors come only from semantic tokens in src/theme/tokens.css (use utilities like bg-surface, text-muted-foreground, border-border). Screens must handle loading, empty, error and no-access states.

checks: pnpm --filter @brd/ui lint (no hardcoded colors outside src/theme/)
theme.typeScale: Exactly three sizes (UAB rule 8): primary 18px (text-3xl and up, text-fs-primary), secondary 16px (text-2xl, text-fs-secondary), supportive 13px (text-xs to text-xl, text-fs-supportive). Phones use 16px in typed fields.
theme.controls: Buttons and compact inputs/selects are 32px (h-control-compact); form inputs and selects are 40px (h-control); touch screens use 44px. Never set a height on a Button; use size=icon for icon buttons and the compact prop on Input and SelectTrigger.
theme.geometry: Rail 60px (w-rail), sidebar 240px (w-sidebar), top bar 56px (h-topbar), drawer 560px (w-drawer). Tokens: --rail-*, --sidebar-bg, --table-row-hover, --grid-header-bg, --empty-value-fg.

avatar.summary: Image with initials fallback. Prefer UserAvatar.

card.summary: Surface container with header, content and footer slots.

form.summary: react-hook-form field wiring (label, control, description, message).
form.notes: Create the form with useZodForm(schema) in apps/web; schemas live in packages/shared.

radio-group.summary: Single choice from a few options.

table.summary: Styled HTML table parts. Use DataTable for server-driven tables.

toast.summary: Toasts. Mount ToastProvider once (already in App.tsx); call toast anywhere.

props.toast.success|error|warning|info: (title: string, description?: string, duration?: number) => void

ActionBar.summary: Fixed-height toolbar row inside a PageShell.

ConfirmDialog.example: <ConfirmDialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen} title="Archive project?" variant="destructive" confirmLabel="Archive" onConfirm={archive} />

CopyButton.summary: Copies a value to the clipboard with feedback.

DatePicker.summary: Template date picker: value is 'YYYY-MM-DD' (or with time), calendar popover, Today and Clear in the footer, arrow-key navigation. Exported from the template overlays.

DelayedFallback.summary: Renders children after a delay to avoid loader flicker.

DiscardGuard.summary: Unsaved-changes guard: DiscardGuardProvider, useDiscardGuard, FooterDiscardGuard, DiscardBar. FormDrawer wires it when `dirty` is set.

EmptyState.summary: Empty list/page message with optional action.
EmptyState.example: <EmptyState icon={FolderKanban} title="No projects yet" actionLabel="New project" onAction={open} />

ErrorBoundary.summary: Catches render errors and shows a retry panel.

FormDrawer.summary: Right-side drawer for create/edit forms: 560px, header as tall as the top bar with the title in 18px and the description behind an ⓘ, footer Cancel plus submit. No × icon. With no onSubmit or footer it shows only Cancel.
FormDrawer.example: <FormDrawer open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen} title="New project" onSubmit={form.handleSubmit(save)} isPending={saving} dirty={form.formState.isDirty}>…fields…</FormDrawer>

FormError.summary: Form-level error text under the fields (field errors use FormMessage). Renders nothing when empty; announced to screen readers.

InfiniteScrollSentinel.summary: Triggers onLoadMore when scrolled into view.

InformativeBar.summary: Back button, badge and right-side actions row. Its title and info text move to the top bar inside the app shell (no title row in the page); outside the shell they render inline.
InformativeBar.example: <InformativeBar title="Projects" info="Projects you can access"><Button size="sm">New</Button></InformativeBar>

NoAccess.example: <NoAccess description="You do not have access to projects." />

PageLoader.summary: Centered spinner for a loading page.

PageShell.summary: Page-height flex column: PageShell > bars > PageShell.Body.

SettingsSection.summary: Titled settings group; SettingsField lays out a label/control row.

StatusBadge.summary: Status as a coloured dot plus coloured text (no background). Use variant="pill" only for a filled badge. Always include a text label.

SwitcherBar.summary: Underline or boxed view switcher (buttons, not role=tab).

TruncatedText.summary: Single-line text with tooltip when truncated.

InfoTip.summary: ⓘ icon after a title or label that holds the explanation (hover, focus, tap). Use instead of visible description sentences.

EmptyValue.summary: The one way to show a missing value: italic light-grey N/A, accessible name 'Not available'.

DateText.summary: Date as '16 Oct, 2026'; full 'Fri, 16 Oct 2026 08:30 AM' in a tooltip. Never use toLocaleString for table dates.

OverflowChips.summary: Chips on one line, as many as fit, then a +N chip whose tooltip lists all.

ConfirmHost.summary: Mount once in App; renders the dialog behind confirmDelete().

confirmDelete.summary: Opens the shared delete/remove/discard confirmation (Cancel focused, red confirm). Every destructive action calls this; never a one-click delete.
confirmDelete.example: confirmDelete({ title: 'Delete note?', message: 'The note is removed. The document stays.', onConfirm: () => remove.mutate(id) })

FormGrid.summary: Fields flow 1→2→3 per row from the container width (min 220px). Use FormGridItem full for long fields.

SelectMenu.summary: The one dropdown: a listbox up to 8 options with type-to-jump, a search panel above that. Optional None choice. 40px in forms, compact 32px in toolbars, tables and footers.

ViewBar.summary: Line 1 of a list page: underline view tabs with a sliding accent line, icon-only "+", Unsaved menu, and Export + primary action at the right.

RecordInspector.summary: Record view as a 560px side drawer: title, status and prev/next in the header; Details/Related/Activity/Comments tabs; one comment box; footer Cancel · Edit.
RecordInspector.example: <RecordInspector open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen} title={row.title} tabs={tabs} onEdit={edit} comment={comment} />

MultiSelectMenu.summary: Multi-select dropdown with search, Select all and Clear all.

Dialog.summary: Template modal dialog (focus trap, Esc, footer slot). Use ConfirmHost + confirmDelete for destructive confirmations.

Popover.summary: Anchored popover that flips near the viewport edge. Anchor is a ref to the trigger.

Menu.summary: Anchored action menu (items with icon, danger, disabledReason).
Menu.example: <Menu open={open} onClose={close} anchor={ref} items={items} label="Row actions" />

AppShell.summary: Four regions: icon rail | context sidebar | workspace (top bar + page). Provides the page-title context.

IconRail.summary: Global rail: module icons on top (selected = own tint, no bar beside it), global tools below. Rail colour comes from the rail skin.

props.modules: RailModule[] ({ key, label, icon, onSelect, badge?, visible? })

RailButton.summary: One rail icon button (use for utilities).

ContextSidebar.summary: Module sidebar: 200-360px resizable, light grey, 30px rows, plain section labels, "Find a page (N)" search, star favourites that move to a Favorites section, collapse icon at the top.
ContextSidebar.example: <ContextSidebar title="Projects" sections={sections} activeKey={key} width={w} onWidthChange={setW} onCollapse={collapse} />

SidebarContent.summary: The sidebar rows without the frame; used inside MobileNav.

MobileNav.summary: Phones: modules and sidebar as one navigation drawer.
MobileNav.example: <MobileNav open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen} modules={modules} activeModuleKey="projects" title="Projects" sections={sections} activeKey={key} />

TopBar.summary: Page title and ⓘ at the left (from the page's InformativeBar/ListPage/DetailPage title), centred search box, tools at the right. No breadcrumbs anywhere.

useSetPageHeader.summary: Registers the page title and description with the top bar. ListPage, DetailPage, FormPage and InformativeBar call it for you; returns false outside the shell so the title renders inline.

CommandPalette.summary: Ctrl/⌘+K search over pages and actions. Pair with useCommandShortcut.

NotificationBell.summary: Bell with unread count and list. Set isSample while the list is not the person's real notifications; it then says so.

AppearanceMenu.summary: Theme, accent colour, sidebar colour and rail skin. Colours are corrected until text reaches WCAG AA. The app stores the value and calls applyAppearance.

UserMenu.summary: Avatar dropdown with extra actions and logout.

DataTable.summary: Server-driven table in the template style: borderless, left-aligned, dot+text statuses, tools line (search, Filters ⌄ with Apply/Clear, Columns ⌄, selection and bulk actions at the right), hover-only row checkboxes, pinned titled Actions column, frozen numbered pagination. Cells show truncated text with a tooltip, dates as DateText and missing values as EmptyValue.

props.columns: DataTableColumnDef[] (id, header, cell?, kind?: 'date', canHide?, sortable?, width)

DataTable.example: <DataTable columns={cols} data={rows} filters={filters} filterValues={values} onApplyFilters={apply} pagination={{ page, pageSize: 25, total }} onPageChange={setPage} />

DataTableToolbar.summary: The tools line. Rendered by DataTable.

DataTablePagination.summary: Frozen footer: "1–25 of N items" left; numbered pages with ellipses and a "25 / page" dropdown right.

ListPage.summary: List screen with all five states. Header via `title`, search in `toolbar` (always visible), table as children, pagination in `footer`, drawers in `overlays`.
ListPage.example: } loadingFallback={} emptyTitle="No projects yet" onRetry={refetch}>…

DetailPage.summary: Detail screen: header (title, badge, back, actions) and role-aware tabs (Radix Tabs, role=tab). Pass only the tabs the user may see; keep the active tab in the URL.
DetailPage.example: <DetailPage state="ready" title={p.name} badge={<StatusBadge … />} onBack={back} tabs={tabs} activeTab={tab} onTabChange={setTab} footer={<ConfirmDialog … />} />

FormPage.summary: Full-page form inside the app shell: header, scrolling body, sticky Cancel/Save footer. For standalone pages outside the shell (login, forced password change) use a Card instead.
FormPage.example: <FormPage state="ready" title="Edit settings" onSubmit={form.handleSubmit(save)} onCancel={back} submitting={saving}>…fields…</FormPage>

ThemeProvider.summary: Applies data-theme (light/dark) from the saved preference or the system. Mount once near the root; index.html also sets data-theme before first paint (key 'brd-theme').

applyAppearance.summary: Writes accent, sidebar colour and rail skin onto <html> (overrides only for non-default choices, text pairs corrected to AA). Also exports ACCENT_PRESETS, SIDEBAR_PRESETS, RAIL_SKINS, DEFAULT_APPEARANCE, contrastRatio.

useSidebarState.summary: Sidebar collapsed state, persisted via safeStorage.

useToast.summary: Hook form of the toast API; the `toast` object works anywhere.

useFormField.summary: Used inside Form components to read field ids and errors.

useDiscardGuard.summary: Access the nearest discard guard (null outside a guarded drawer).

useDiscardGuardState.summary: Create discard-guard state for custom dialogs.

cn.summary: Merge Tailwind class names (clsx + tailwind-merge). Never concatenate class strings.

safeStorage.summary: localStorage get/set that never throws. Use for UI preferences only.

getInitials.summary: Up to two uppercase initials from a name.

copyToClipboard.summary: Copy text; resolves to success boolean.
